prompt: The attached image is a 240x294 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240, initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden character</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:#faf9f4}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf8f7f2);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,147,-147,.1,1500);
ref.position.set(0,147,600);
ref.lookAt(0,147,0);

function group(parent,name){
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const figure=group(scene,'golden-pear-character');
const trunk=group(figure,'torso');
const head=group(figure,'head');
const eyes=group(head,'eyes');
const mouth=group(head,'mouth');

// Each row describes a horizontal oval in the sculpt, from crown to base.
// Coordinates follow the reference frame, with depth measured toward the viewer.
function skin(parent,name,rows){
  const curves=[1,2,3,4].map(k=>new THREE.SplineCurve(rows.map((r,i)=>new THREE.Vector2(i,r[k]))));
  const positions=[],colors=[],idx=[];
  const sides=72, steps=(rows.length-1)*5;
  for(let j=0;j<=steps;j++){
    const u=j/steps, f=u*(rows.length-1), a=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.floor(f)), t=f-a;
    const y=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(rows[a][0],rows[a+1][0],t);
    const [x,z,w,d]=curves.map(c=>c.getPoint(u).y);
    const col=new THREE.Color(rows[a][5]).lerp(new THREE.Color(rows[a+1][5]),t);
    for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
      const ang=i/sides*Math.PI*2, sn=Math.sin(ang),cs=Math.cos(ang);
      positions.push(x-120+Math.max(.025,w)*sn,294-y,z+Math.max(.025,d)*cs);
      const shade=1+.022*Math.sin(3*ang+.032*y);
      colors.push(col.r*shade,col.g*shade,col.b*shade);
      if(i<sides&&j<steps){
        const b=j*(sides+1)+i;
        idx.push(b,b+sides+1,b+1,b+1,b+sides+1,b+sides+2);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.89,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
  m.name=name;parent.add(m);return m;
}
function oval(parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,d,color){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,32,20),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.9}));
  m.name=name;m.position.set(x-120,294-y,z);m.scale.set(w,h,d);parent.add(m);return m;
}

skin(trunk,'continuous pear-shaped body',[
 [33,101,-2,.1,.1,0xe8b337],[40,101,-2,19,17,0xe4ad26],
 [54,99,-2,26,23,0xe7aa26],[70,97,-2,34,28,0xf1b527],
 [88,96,-1,40,33,0xffc72c],[105,96,1,44,36,0xffcd56],
 [122,96,3,50,40,0xffdd94],[140,97,4,55,44,0xfad386],
 [161,99,4,57,45,0xe9af56],[180,100,2,57,43,0xf1b134],
 [196,100,0,53,39,0xecaa26],[211,99,-1,45,32,0xe5a025],
 [224,98,-1,36,24,0xd99725],[231,97,-1,23,16,0xc98b21],[234,97,-1,.1,.1,0xc48724]
]);
skin(head,'rounded crown and cheeks',[
 [17.5,100,0,.1,.1,0xffcf48],[19,100,0,9,8,0xf9c643],
 [23,101,0,16,14,0xf6c330],[31,102,0,20,18,0xf5bd28],
 [40,101,1,22,20,0xeeb52c],[49,100,1,23,22,0xe6a632],
 [59,99,0,25,22,0xd99a30],[70,98,-2,22,19,0xe4a22e],[78,98,-2,.1,.1,0xeaaa32]
]);
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const s=side<0?'left':'right';
  const leg=group(figure,s+'-leg');
  const x=side<0?79:119;
  skin(leg,s+' tapered leg',[
    [188,x,0,.1,.1,0xeaaa2b],[198,x,-1,20,23,0xedac32],
    [215,x,-1,21,22,0xe4a129],[234,x,-1,18.3,19,0xdb9325],
    [255,x+(side<0?2:-2),0,15.4,17,0xdb952a],
    [281,x+(side<0?5:-5),1,13,15,0xdf982a],
    [304,x+(side<0?6:-6),1,11.4,14,0xd89428],
    [312,x+(side<0?6:-6),3,10,15,0xc98a23],[317,x+(side<0?6:-6),4,.1,.1,0xc98a23]
  ]);
  const arm=group(figure,s+'-arm'),hand=group(arm,s+'-hand');
  const X=v=>side<0?v:195-v;
  const off=side<0?0:4;
  skin(arm,'sloping shoulder and arm',[
    [65,X(73),-5,.1,.1,0xf4be32],[74,X(66),-5,10,12,0xffca34],
    [88,X(61),-4,11,13,0xf8bf2c],[105,X(57),-4,9,11,0xefaf21],
    [126,X(51),-4,6,9,0xecb037],[151,X(46),-3,4.6,7,0xd9a044],
    [168+off,X(42),-1,4.8,6,0xd6a24a],[181+off,X(39),1,4.5,5,0x927235],
    [191+off,X(36),2,3.7,4,0x524832],[194+off,X(35),2,.1,.1,0x50432c]
  ]);
  const palm=oval(hand,'palm',X(34),194+off,2,6.2,12,4.8,0x51452b);
  palm.rotation.z=-side*-.33;
  for(let k=0;k<4;k++){
    const bx=29+k*2.8,by=198+off;
    const end=by+[14,17,16,12][k];
    skin(hand,'finger-'+(k+1),[
      [by-4,X(bx+1),3,.1,.1,0x574832],[by,X(bx),3,2.1,2.3,0x51432e],
      [by+6,X(bx-2.4),4,1.8,2,0x493d2b],[end-2,X(bx-2),5,1.4,1.5,0x534731],
      [end,X(bx-1.5),5,.1,.1,0x635337]
    ]);
  }
  const thumb=oval(hand,'thumb',X(40),198+off,5,2.4,7,2.5,0x615136);
  thumb.rotation.z=side*.2;
  const eye=group(eyes,s+'-eye');
  const ex=side<0?88.5:114.4;
  const lid=oval(eye,'heavy eyelid',ex,36,15.7,6,4.2,3.3,0xdba835);
  lid.rotation.z=side*-.10;
  oval(eye,'shaded eye slit',ex+.4,38,17.6,3.6,1.15,1.6,0xac8532);
}
oval(head,'low broad muzzle',102,46,21,13.3,5.2,5.6,0xe2a838);
skin(mouth,'quiet curved mouth',[
 [48.2,102.5,26,.1,.1,0x9f762c],[48.8,102.5,26,7.7,.85,0x96722d],
 [49.6,102.8,26,9.5,1,0x795c27],[50.6,103,25.8,6.5,.8,0x926b2c],
 [51.1,103,25.6,.1,.1,0xb48330]
]);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff7df,0xe4be89,1.65));
function sun(x,y,z,color,power){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,power);l.position.set(x,y,z);scene.add(l);
}
sun(-100,210,130,0xfff7da,1.5);
sun(100,90,-100,0xffdf98,1.05);

// A distant studio sweep with the fine color variation of the GIF palette.
const bg=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1600,1200),new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
 depthWrite:false,
 vertexShader:`varying vec2 p;
 void main(){p=(modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.)).xy;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.);}`,
 fragmentShader:`varying vec2 p;
 float hash(vec2 a){return fract(sin(dot(a,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}
 void main(){
 float h=p.y;
 vec3 c=mix(vec3(.70,.68,.61),vec3(.995,.99,.98),smoothstep(-3.,45.,h));
 c=mix(c,vec3(.88,.90,.99),exp(-pow((h-245.)/16.,2.))*.72);
 c=mix(c,vec3(.93,.92,.84),smoothstep(248.,297.,h)*.9);
 vec2 q=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
 c+=(vec3(hash(q),hash(q+37.),hash(q+91.))-.5)*(.028+.080*smoothstep(180.,285.,h)+.06*(1.-smoothstep(10.,44.,h)));
 gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);}`
}));
bg.name='studio backdrop';bg.position.set(0,147,-360);bg.renderOrder=-10;scene.add(bg);
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref);}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[figure],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
